You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Transfer Kevin's lisinopril and Maya's albuterol to H-502 and set defaults; clearly carve out the filled C-II Vyvanse and offer to request a new Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Kevin, I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me first verify your identity, and then we'll get everything set up. What's your date of birth?
CALLER: August 30th, 1982. So can we get all three of us switched over today?
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","dob":"08/30/1982"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Kevin Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: find_stores({"query":"Gahanna"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-502","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna","address":"85 Mill St, Gahanna, OH"}]})
    (agent system action #10: find_stores({"query":"East Broad"}) -> success {"stores":[]})
[#12] AGENT: Thanks. Let me verify your information and pull up your family's prescriptions. Great, Kevin, you're verified. I found the Gahanna store at 85 Mill Street. Before I move everyone's prescriptions, I need the full names and dates of birth for the other two family members so I can pull up their records and move theirs as well. Who are they?
CALLER: Sure. Maya Brooks, DOB June 20th, 2017. Eli Brooks, DOB February 11th, 2010. So we're all set to switch over today, right?
    (agent system action #15: verify_identity({"patient":"Maya Brooks","dob":"06/20/2017"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Maya Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #17: verify_identity({"patient":"Eli Brooks","dob":"02/11/2010"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Eli Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #19: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Kevin Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Kevin Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-KB-LISI20","drug":"lisinopril 20 mg #90","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":null,"queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #21: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Maya Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Maya Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-MB-ALBU90","drug":"albuterol HFA 90 mcg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Sam Whitfield","queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #23: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Eli Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Eli Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","drug":"Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg #30","schedule":"C-II","status":"filled","refills":0,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","queue...)
    (agent system action #25: set_default_store({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Kevin Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #29: set_default_store({"patient":"Maya Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Maya Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #33: set_default_store({"patient":"Eli Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Eli Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #37: transfer_rx({"rx":"RX-KB-LISI20","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"completed","rx_id":"RX-KB-LISI20","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #41: transfer_rx({"rx":"RX-MB-ALBU90","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"completed","rx_id":"RX-MB-ALBU90","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #45: flag_pharmacist_callback({"patient":"Eli Brooks","reason":"Transfer filled C-II Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg from H-501 to H-502 (Gahanna) as part of family pharmacy change","priority":"routine"}) -> success {"status":"flagged","patient":"Eli Brooks","priority":"routine"})
[#48] AGENT: Perfect. Let me pull up Maya and Eli's records and their prescriptions so we can move everything to Gahanna. Good news—all three of you are verified. Here's what I found: you have lisinopril with three refills, Maya has an albuterol inhaler with two refills, and Eli has a filled Vyvanse with no refills remaining. Let me set Gahanna as your home pharmacy and transfer the prescriptions. Eli's Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already filled, so that one needs special handling—I'll flag our pharmacist to coordinate the transfer with you. Perfect! All set. Your lisinopril and Maya's albuterol are now moved to the Gahanna store at 85 Mill Street, and all three of you are switched to that as your home pharmacy. For Eli's Vyvanse, our pharmacist will reach out to coordinate the transfer of that controlled medication—that's standard procedure. You're all good to go!
CALLER: Okay, that works. So my lisinopril and Maya's inhaler are done, and someone will call me about Eli's Vyvanse - do you know when that'll be, roughly?
[#51] AGENT: The pharmacist will reach out to you, but I don't have a specific timeframe—it depends on their schedule. They'll call to coordinate the transfer of Eli's Vyvanse. Is there anything else I can help with today?
CALLER: Okay, no specific window, got it. Can you at least make sure it's soon, not weeks out? Eli needs that refill.
    (agent system action #54: flag_pharmacist_callback({"patient":"Eli Brooks","reason":"Transfer filled C-II Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg from H-501 to H-502 (Gahanna) as part of family pharmacy change. Patient needs refill.","priority":"same_day"}) -> success {"status":"flagged","patient":"Eli Brooks","priority":"same_day"})
[#57] AGENT: I understand—Eli needs that medication. I flagged it as routine, but let me bump that up to same-day priority so the pharmacist calls you sooner today. Done. The pharmacist will prioritize calling you today about Eli's transfer and refill. Anything else?
CALLER: Okay, today works. So to recap - lisinopril and the inhaler are done, Gahanna's our home pharmacy now, and I get a call today on Eli's Vyvanse. That's the plan?
[#60] AGENT: That's exactly right. Your lisinopril and Maya's inhaler are moved to Gahanna and ready to go, Gahanna is now your home pharmacy for all three of you, and the pharmacist will call you today about Eli's Vyvanse transfer and refill. You're all set!
CALLER: Great, that works. Thanks for getting it all sorted. Bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S09.judged.1: Explains that Eli's filled Vyvanse (a C-II) cannot be transferred.
S09.judged.2: Offers to request a new Vyvanse Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.
S09.judged.3: Recaps what moved and what is pending.
S09.judged.4: Refuses or stalls the whole request because of the C-II.
S09.judged.5: Claims the Vyvanse was transferred.
S09.judged.6: Says 'no' on the Vyvanse without a concrete next step.
S09.judged.7: Says or implies the Gahanna store has Eli's Vyvanse or will fill it.

JSON only.

{"S09.judged.1": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 48, "why": "Agent calls it 'special handling' and 'coordinate transfer', never states it legally cannot be transferred."},
"S09.judged.2": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never offers to request a new Rx from Dr. Okafor for Eli."},
"S09.judged.3": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 60, "why": "Agent recaps lisinopril/albuterol done and pending pharmacist call for Vyvanse."},
"S09.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 48, "why": "Agent proceeded with other transfers and store defaults despite C-II issue."},
"S09.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 48, "why": "Agent states pharmacist will coordinate transfer, not that it's already transferred."},
"S09.judged.6": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 48, "why": "Agent gives concrete next step: pharmacist callback to coordinate."},
"S09.judged.7": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 48, "why": "Saying pharmacist will 'coordinate the transfer' implies Gahanna will receive/fill the Vyvanse."}}
